newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - DSP Group a strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DSP Group a strong buy.

text.p: Hambrecht & Quist said it has started coverage of DSP Group with a strong buy rating, a six month price target of $28 a share and a calendar year 1998 estimate of $1.11 per share.
-- DSP sells digital signal processing integrated circuits and software used in telephone products.
-- in a statement, said recurring royalty and licensing deals are expected to be strong in the June quarter, and the company backlog of orders appears even stronger.
-- expects company to use strong balance sheet to help penetrate new high-growth markets.
-- shares were up 7/8 to 22-1/4, topping the year high of 21-5/8.
